name: Dominique Frot
bio:
Dominique Frot is a French actress, (August 23, 1957 - August 7, 2026).

Dominique Frot was born on August 23, 1957, in Rochefort, France. She is the sister of actress Catherine Frot. After studying at the Conservatoire National Supérieur d’Art Dramatique and subsequently at the École Normale de Musique de Paris, she began her acting career in the theater. She made her film debut in 1982 in the spy movie *Enigma*.

In 2019, she ran in the European elections, holding the eighteenth spot on the *Urgence Écologie* list led by Dominique Bourg, in a coalition with GÉ, the MDP, the MEI, and the UDE. Source: "Dominique Frot" article from the French Wikipedia, licensed under CC-BY-SA.
